verdict.rationale: ClickUp's Brain² lets users ask natural-language questions across their workspace and delegate tasks to agents, and ClickUp offers a 'build your own agent' capability, suggesting NL-driven operation of the product. However, evidence is vendor-marketing only, with no independent hands-on confirmation of how broadly NL commands can actually drive task/workflow operations. Missing for 10: independent verification of NL command execution, detailed documentation of command scope and reliability, and no community corroboration (only unrelated general product-quality complaints).
